Resolved per the bead's recommendation (options a + c):

(a) Added a "Backend trait rule: secret-minting methods require CSPRNG" section to crate-jmap-server/AGENTS.md immediately after the "Design Constraints (Settled)" table. The new section codifies:
    1. Doc-comment-must-require-CSPRNG rule for any new credential-minting backend method.
    2. Reference MemoryBackend-must-use-OsRng/getrandom rule.
    3. Links back to bd:JMAP-sc1b.78 (invite-code trait doc precedent) and bd:JMAP-sc1b.93 (reference-impl audit precedent).

(c) Filed bd:JMAP-sc1b.107 as the concrete implementation work item for the RFC 8620 §7.2 PushSubscription server-side surface. The new bead's description carries the CSPRNG requirement verbatim so it cannot be missed by whoever picks it up.

Option (b) (skeleton trait now) deferred — premature without the rest of the §7.2 surface around it.

Verified: cargo fmt + cargo clippy --workspace + cargo test --workspace all pass (no code changes in this resolution, only AGENTS.md prose).
